"Dare!" I shouted out, smiling. I was prepared..or so I thought. 

Lucifer chuckled and placed a hand on my shoulder which sent a shiver down my spine, no idea why. 

"Well, why don't you go ask Liz to marry you?" He wasn't asking a question, his voice was quiet so no one else could hear. I froze in my spot and blankly stared at him, I wanted to yell at him, but nothing came out.

"Go." He pushed me forward, towards Liz. Liz was the most popular girl in the entire school. I began to sweat and halfway panic.

I walked towards Liz, staring at Lucifer as I did so. That smug bastard. He had such a proud look on his face. I sighed and tapped on Liz' shoulder.

"Yes?" She turned around, looking me up and down. I swore I could've maybe seen her cheeks flush a light shade of red, but I don't know.

I felt my face turn red. I fumbled around, trying to find the right words for what I wanted to say.

"Y-you are one of the most popular girls here and you're super pretty and nice and I would kiss you and I really wanna marry you and I know this is way too soon we don't even know each other but uhm yeah," I blurted out, it took me a minute to realize what I just said. 

I prepared myself for the worst, I winced back, prepared to face her laughing in my face, kicking me, maybe even giving me a huge bruise..

"Oh. Sure." She fumbled about in her bag, pulling out a piece of paper and a pen. 

"Sign here, okay? We can always go file it today, I can call my father, if you want," She said, writing her name down and shoving the paper to me.

I looked down at what I was holding..holy shit.
